raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Maria Luisa of Savoy’s father-in-law was Louis XIV by assuming Philip V was Louis XIV’s son. In reality, Philip V was the son of Louis, Grand Dauphin (and grandson of Louis XIV). This misinterpretation, despite later evidence indicating “Philip was a son of the dauphin Louis (son of Louis XIV of France),” led to the wrong identification of the father-in-law.
